diagnosis.reproduced_defect: The fixture returned after reading headers without consuming the declared POST body.
diagnosis.evidence_strength: A synchronization barrier forced headers to be read before the body was sent. The original fixture captured zero body bytes; expected body length was 11 bytes.
diagnosis.hosted_causation_limit: The exact hosted low-level transport error was not captured. The fixture defect is consistent with the failure, but connection reset versus deadline was not established from hosted logs.
diagnosis.deadline_scope: APR validates input, obtains the credential binding and builds the request before ureq starts its global transport timer. ureq 3.4.2 sends request headers and body in separate transport phases.

limitations: No native credential backend test was run.
This correction is not part of the triggering hosted run; a subsequent hosted matrix is required.
